<TALK 1><NAME 1><CHAR 1,1,1,2,3><CV 1,5>We discovered something that seems amazing,
so we came to report!

This is a censer.
And the embedded jewels
are the positions of the stars then.

And the horns around it...
these seem to be monster horns
hardened by special processing.

But this colour...
what monster's horn could it be...

<CV 5,4>Mm, it matches the words on the tablet.
This is surely the treasure.

I'll investigate the details later.
Drop by when you're near.

<ITEM 0,1,0><TALK 5><NAME 13><CHAR 5,0,11,0,1>Um...
that seems to be the ritual vessel I seek...

<TALK 5><NAME 10><CHAR 5,0,7,0,0><CV 5,35>Ritual vessel...
Mm, that could be possible.

The treasures of the Fractured Isles
all have some story behind them.

It wouldn't be strange if some of them
were ritual vessels...

<TALK 1><NAME 1><CHAR 1,0,1,0,1>Then, truly...
That the treasure was a ritual vessel!

Yuno, to find your companion too,
let's do our best together!
<CV 1,6>From now on too, nice to meet you!
